content.short: Reality Rush is a Telegram and TON city-builder where players grow a city, collect points, and earn rewards.
content.description: Reality Rush is a city-building Telegram Mini App connected to TON. Public TON App and project coverage describe claiming buildings, placing them in a city, collecting RP points, investing in city services, completing tasks, and earning RRUSH-related rewards. The game is a city-builder and reward loop, not just a token listing. Reality Metaverse - +2000 fNFTs with royalties. Reality Rush is a game listing because users interact through play, progression, competition, collectibles, rewards, or community challenges.
